description: Verse paints one picture from a text prompt (up to 400 characters), safe for work. One call, one picture. Costs 0.05 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) per call, paid with x402 over MCP: call it without payment to get the PaymentRequired terms in structuredContent, then call it again with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. The settlement comes back in result._meta["x402/payment-response"]. A call that cannot be done (bad input, the service busy) is never charged. The same service over HTTP: POST https://a-to-mind.com/api/x402/image.

prompt.description: what to paint, up to 400 characters

shape.description: square, portrait, landscape or wide, optional

style.description: a style from the page's list, optional

name: paid_image
title: Paint a picture from a prompt (0.05 USDC, x402)
